A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PPLLaVA study, with complete main text, references and Appendices A–C. All 18 pages were inspected; pages 2–18 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v3 reports original PPLLaVA benchmark results, component and pooling ablations, efficiency measurements and qualitative video-dialogue examples in Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–8.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, ablations, efficiency measurements and qualitative results, including Appendix A.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 retain identical vision-prompt alignment, prompt-guided pooling, CLIP context extension and training procedures. No method component or model operation changes.

E1.justification: The training sources, seven video benchmarks in Table 2, image benchmarks in Table 4 and qualitative test scenarios in Appendix A are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical throughout Tables 1–5, including InstructBLIP, the video and image baselines, and alternative pooling and token-merging methods.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same model sizes, 32/64-frame sampling, GPT-based and multiple-choice evaluations, and training settings. The redundancy-study and ablation protocols also remain identical.

E4.justification: The redundancy analysis in Section 3.1, component and pooling ablations in Section 4.3, spatial/temporal sensitivity plots, and Appendix A attention visualizations and dialogue examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting and plots. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 2 reports VideoMME Overall scores of 64.5 for PPLLaVA (LLaVA-Video) and 67.1 for PPLLaVA (InternVL3) in both versions.

T1.justification: The certificate definition in Section 3.1 and alignment, pooling and interpolation equations (1)–(4) are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about instruction-aware compression, up to 18× token reduction, improved efficiency and performance across image and video tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations of prompt relevance and efficiency/performance trade-offs are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitations concerning model size, context length and dependence on informative prompts.

D1.justification: Implementation, training-data, hyperparameter and hardware disclosures are identical, including one training epoch, learning rate 2e-5 and batch size 256. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2, cited works and the bibliography are unchanged. Positioning relative to Q-Formers, existing pooling methods and key-frame extraction remains identical.

P1.justification: v4 adds Wei Gao to the author list and gives the first three authors dual Peng Cheng Laboratory/Peking University affiliations. Affiliation ordering and numbering and the arXiv version/date stamp change; body and appendix prose and structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author and affiliation block is slightly rearranged to accommodate the update. All five tables, eight figures, captions and page layouts from page 2 onward render identically.

improvement.justification: v4 updates authorship, affiliations and version identification while preserving the scientific narrative, methods, results, reproducibility details and appendices. These limited first-page changes establish no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
